decision: RESEARCH_PLAN decisions 2026-10-05 (field-order bug and repair plan)
agent_version: gp-bo-prior-v1.1 (slowlab/prior_bo.py; inputs mapped by name into policy_order)

anchor.role: day-0 policy of one compartment and centre of the initial design

mean: constant, estimated within each campaign by generalised least squares; no development mean surface

hyperparameter_evidence.kernel_choice: higher cross-season ranking accuracy; ties by lower random RMSE
hyperparameter_evidence.parameters_at_bounds: gamma near 0 (policy effect common to both seasons) and noise ratio at its 1e-4 floor

radius_unit: half-width of the box trust region as a fraction of each policy field range
radius_selection_rule: highest mean evaluated score over development sites 0-7 (distribution v1, development master seed 20260930), 2 method seeds x Full/Endpoint, three development evaluation years each; ties by lower SD between seeds
acceptance: the selected radius must score on average at least the fixed reference on the same development sites and years; the criterion never refers to language-model results

turbo.failure_tolerance: ceil(max(4/q, d/q)), q = crops in the batch, d = 6

policy_order_source: the field order of configs/task_contract_v8.json, in which the kernel was fitted (results/prior_bo_hyperparameter_fit_20261003.json, inputs)

supersedes.change: records the kernel input order; the radius is selected again on development sites with the fixed agent (same rule and candidates)
